statements.markdown: **Corollary 10.7 (Only $C_D\in\{-2,-1\}$ remain among the exceptional dyadic cells).** *At a final middle row $D\ge13$, Theorem [10.6](#thm:cd-neg3-impossible) removes $-3$ from the exceptional set $\{-3,-2,-1\}$, leaving $-2,-1$ *within that set*. It does not assert $C_D\in\{-2,-1\}$: nonnegative values have not been excluded. Proposition [10.5](#prop:upper-unconditional) handles upper transitions in the two-sided induction; it supplies no additional restriction on a middle coordinate. For the all-middle-row induction, the exclusion of all three values still needs proof without an all-right-tail assumption, together with the separate right-branch inequality.*
